blurb: Guests can rent various watercraft including Yamaha Jet Skis, powerboats, and pontoon boats. Parasailing flights are offered from the marina with options for single, double, and triple flights. The marina also has a retail shop selling accessories, water-sports equipment, and safety gear, plus a cafe on site.
